validity_findings: Positive control B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT passes 240/240 with 240/240 raw-byte passthrough and 0 transport errors, confirming the localhost environment and decompression logic are valid. CDN inferences are licensed.

CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare free tier, quick tunnel, edge sjc01) was reachable and returned HTTP 200 for all 273 CDN responses (240 main + 18 cache + 15 identity). Zero transport errors across all 513 rows. Tunnel health probes verified before measurement.

Measurement validity is established: raw evidence (verbatim headers, raw-body SHA256, timing) preserved distinct from derived measurements in raw_cell_results.jsonl. No auto-decode middleware used (raw http.client reads).
Chunk sizes 8192/32 refer to decompressor feed granularity; network reads used 8192-byte frames over TLS. Real TCP segmentation and TLS framing through Cloudflare applied to all CDN rows.

Content-Encoding headers recorded per observation; cf-cache-status was DYNAMIC on all 273 CDN responses (no HIT observed). This means C3 cache stability tested consecutive-serve stability only, not stale-cache serving behavior. Do not interpret C3 PASS as 'CDN caching is safe'.

Single Cloudflare edge (sjc01) via one quick tunnel. Geographic distribution across edges, paid-tier behaviors, other CDN providers (Fastly, Akamai, CloudFront), payloads >100KB, depths 3-5, other quality/level settings, concurrent clients, and HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 differences remain untested per prereg claim ceiling.

BINARY payload bodies vary across interpreter sessions (hash(state) depends on PYTHONHASHSEED). Ground truth was computed within-run from the same bytes served, so within-run correctness comparisons are valid. Cross-run BINARY ground-truth reproducibility remains unknown.
Compression levels executed: gzip level 1, brotli quality 4 (parent-faithful). Spec ceiling text mentions gzip default level 6; actual executed levels match parent run_experiment.py.

Two pre-registration-conformant execution bugs were fixed before any outcome-bearing measurement (tunnel-stdout blocking read; HTTPS hostname attribute). No frozen design element (conditions, N, decision rule) was altered.
Jitter 200-500ms between CDN requests, unique URLs per main-matrix observation plus Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 on origin. 1s spacing for cache triplets. Cache-busting protocol followed.

claim_ceiling: The experiment FALSIFIES the hypothesis that iterative decompression (brotli→gzip→identity, max_depth=5) of high-entropy multi-layer compressed payloads served through Cloudflare free-tier CDN produces byte-identical output to ground truth under Accept-Encoding negotiation. The maximum justified claim is bounded to: CDN Accept-Encoding negotiation transforms (gunzip when client omits gzip, always de-brotli origin brotli, silent re-encode under unchanged header, gzip-compress identity text) break fixed-origin-order streaming decompression. The forensic finding that encoding-agnostic iterative decode (sniff delivered bytes, try brotli→gzip until identity) recovers ground truth on 24/24 JSON/HTML CDN deliveries is a hypothesis for the next experiment, not an established result of this packet. Claim ceiling: Cloudflare free tier, single edge (sjc01), 10KB nominal, depth 2, gzip L1 / brotli q4, sequential requests, no cache HIT observed. C-MEAS-VALID remains blocked from Product Core promotion pending encoding-agnostic decompression fix validated through same CDN protocol.
unresolved: Whether encoding-agnostic iterative decode (shown recoverable on 24/24 JSON/HTML forensic deliveries) restores 240/240 correctness through the CDN was not executed as a frozen condition; it is the recommended next test, not an established result of this packet.
CDN-cache HIT staleness: no cf-cache HIT was observed (all DYNAMIC), so stale-cache serving behavior remains untested; a cacheable content-type/extension design would be needed.

Other CDN providers (Fastly, Akamai, CloudFront), paid-tier behaviors, payloads >100KB, depths 3-5, other quality/level settings, concurrent clients, and HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 behavioral differences remain untested per prereg claim ceiling.
BINARY forensic ground-truth comparison is in-session only (BINARY bodies depend on PYTHONHASHSEED per parent handoff); cross-run BINARY ground-truth reproducibility remains unknown.

The specific interaction between CDN Accept-Encoding negotiation and multi-layer compression order (GZIP-OUTER vs BROTLI-OUTER) is diagnosed but the full parameter space of CDN encoding behaviors (quality upgrades, Vary semantics, ETag interaction) is not exhausted.
